title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - Trailer
description: Non-self-propelled vehicle that is designed and constructed to be towed by a power-driven vehicle, as defined in UNECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.4 class O (s4auto:Trailer, subclass of s4auto:Vehicle). Shares Vehicle's core positional/kinematic properties conceptually.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Trailer'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. WGS84 position, modeling s4auto:Position / s4auto:GeoPosition.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

heading.description: Property. Orientation of the horizontal velocity vector (s4auto:Heading), in degrees.

speed.description: Property. Magnitude of the velocity vector (s4auto:Velocity3d), in m/s.

trailerWidth.description: Property. Width of the trailer, in metres (s4auto:Trailer_trailerWidth, a kind of s4auto:VehicleWidth).

frontOverhang.description: Property. Length of the trailer overhang in the positive x direction (ISO 8855) from the trailer reference point, in metres (s4auto:Trailer_frontOverhang). Defaults to 0 if not overhanging to the front.

rearOverhang.description: Property. Length of the trailer overhang in the negative x direction (ISO 8855) from the trailer reference point, in metres (s4auto:Trailer_rearOverhang).

hitchAngle.description: Property. Angle between the trailer orientation and the direction of the segment joining the trailer and the towing vehicle/trailer reference points, in degrees (s4auto:Trailer_hitchAngle). Measured with a confidence level of 95%.

hitchPointOffset.description: Property. Position of the hitch point in the negative x-direction (ISO 8855) from the vehicle reference point, in metres (s4auto:Trailer_hitchPointOffset).

towingVehicle.description: Relationship. The Vehicle (or another Trailer) towing this trailer (inverse of s4auto:Vehicle saref:consistsOf Trailer).
